Waddell, Arizona | Waddell is an unincorporated community in Maricopa County, Arizona, United States, northwest of the city of Phoenix. It was this firm that organized the private financing for construction of the dam for the water reclamation project that creates Lake Pleasant.  The intended Waddell town site was laid out by Donald W. Waddell in 1935, on property he owned on the northeast corner of Waddell Road and Cotton Lane (Section 12, T3N, R2W, G&SRB&M).
